# RAWG Video Games Database

The largest video game database and video game discovery service with comprehensive game information, ratings, platforms, and release dates.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/rawg-video-games-database/.

## Actions

- **Get Game Details** (read-only): Get comprehensive details of a specific game.
- **List Game Creators** (read-only): Get a list of game creators from the RAWG database.
- **List Game Developers** (read-only): Get a list of game developers from the RAWG database.
- **List Games** (read-only): Get a list of games from RAWG database.
- **List Tags** (read-only): Get a list of tags from the RAWG database.
- **List Video Game Genres** (read-only): Get a list of video game genres from RAWG database.
- **List Video Game Platforms** (read-only): Get a list of video game platforms from RAWG database.
- **List Video Game Publishers** (read-only): Get a list of video game publishers from the RAWG database.
- **List Video Game Stores** (read-only): Get a list of video game storefronts.
- **Get Creator Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific creator.
- **Get Creator Roles List** (read-only): Get a list of creator positions (jobs) in the gaming industry.
- **Get Developer Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific developer from the RAWG database.
- **Get Game Achievements** (read-only): Get a list of achievements for a specific game.
- **Get Game Additions List** (read-only): Get a list of DLCs, GOTY editions, companion apps, and other additions for a game.
- **Get Game Development Team List** (read-only): Get a list of individual creators from the development team of a specific game.
- **Get Game Reddit Posts** (read-only): Get a list of most recent posts from a game's subreddit.
- **Get Game Screenshots** (read-only): Get screenshots for a specific game from the RAWG database.
- **Get Game Series List** (read-only): Get a list of games that are part of the same series.
- **Get Game Store Links** (read-only): Get links to stores that sell a specific game.
- **Get Game Trailers** (read-only): Get a list of game trailers and gameplay clips from the RAWG database.
- **Get Genre Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific video game genre.
- **Get Parent Games List** (read-only): Get a list of parent games for DLCs and editions.
- **Get Platform Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific gaming platform from the RAWG database.
- **Get Publisher Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific publisher from the RAWG database.
- **Get Store Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific video game store.
- **Get Tag Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific tag from the RAWG database.
- **List Parent Platforms** (read-only): Get a list of parent platforms from RAWG database.
